sents.zh: 中国人很早就开始喝茶。
sents.en: Chinese people began drinking tea very early.

sents.zh: 宋朝的人非常喜欢喝茶。
sents.en: Song people loved tea very much.

sents.zh: 茶是用山上的一种树做的。
sents.en: Tea is made from a plant that grows on the hills.

sents.zh: 水不能太热，也不能太冷。
sents.en: The water must be neither too hot nor too cold.
Only good water makes good tea.
They looked at the tea, and smelled it.

sents.zh: 喝茶的时候，人们坐下来慢慢说话。
sents.en: While drinking tea, people sat and talked slowly.

sents.zh: 喝茶变成了一件很美的事。
sents.en: Drinking tea became a beautiful thing to do.

sents.zh: 今天，中国人还是很爱喝茶。
sents.en: Today, Chinese people still love drinking tea.
